newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Smurfit executive David Austin resigns.
newsitem.headline: Smurfit executive David Austin resigns.

text.p: Irish paper and packaging manufacturer Jefferson Smurfit Plc said on Monday that Executive vice president sales and marketing, David Austin has decided to resign for health reasons.
Austin, who steps down on February 1, will remain on the Board and will continue to be available to the Group on a consultancy basis, Smurfit said in a statement.

"David has been a part of the core team which has managed the development of the Group over the last three decades, during which it has grown from a locally traded Irish company to become the world's largest paper based packaging group," Michael Smurfit, Group Chairman and Chief Executive Officer said.
